_comments: Form section icons and descriptions, keyed by EntityField.Category (bc-aidp-next-golive#298).
CodeGen reads FieldCategoryInfo for each section's icon; a category with no entry gets a
keyword default (a name containing 'Details' gets fa-align-left), which is why these are pinned.
The value is a JSON object, not a string containing JSON. It is replaced wholesale, so each
row carries every category the entity's setting already had.
Organizations: the two rows the migrations seeded (same IDs), plus 'Organization Metrics', the
category metadata/entity-fields/.form-layout.json gives ActivePersonCount. FieldCategoryIcons is
the legacy twin of FieldCategoryInfo and is kept in step.
Dev loop after editing: mj migrate -> mj sync push --dir metadata -> mj codegen.

Address Information.description: Primary location and office address details

Organizational Metrics.description: Summary statistics and counts related to the organization

Organization Metrics.description: Counts of the people currently associated with the organization

Job Function Details.description: Name, description, display order and status of the job function

Seniority Details.description: Name, description, display order and status of the seniority level

Assignments.description: The person and the job function assigned to them

Function Details.description: Order, source and confidence of the assignment
